title: The merge tool's pre-push step runs the whole checks job, not only its lint part
why: Batch 71's integration PR #2506 went red in CI on a test the batch runner never ran locally, which cost a drop and a rebuild.
note: Incident (coordinator 02:33 CST Nov 10): runner 8 ran only the lint part of the checks job before pushing batch 71; #2506 went red on test_shared_names case (g), a literal tag copy in #1538. Runner 8 dropped #1538 and rebuilt batch-71b (#2507, 11 lanes). The runner's own fix: run `bin/ci-job checks` in full before each push. Guard: the merge tool's pre-push step runs the whole checks job. Tension: the full job already passes the 1200 s lane-lint cap (step lane-lint-cap, doing), so the batch pre-push run needs its own budget or that step's speed-up first. Related, done: batch-local-checks-match-ci. Coordinator 11:31 CST Nov 10: runner 8 (session_013NEJL2vsmyKzJm8jUDt6za) builds it with its own agents after closed #2551 (batch 72, 39 lanes) merges; a freeze exception because it fixes how the queue lands on main, and the owner's 11:26 CST reading that live sessions build with their own agents. Blocked on closed #2551 (open at 11:33 CST). Unblocked 12:32 CST Nov 10: closed #2551 merged as part of batch 72 (main a8a9fcdd5, coordinator 12:30 CST); runner 8 builds it now, from batch 73. Wait on closed #2551 is void 13:18 CST Nov 10 (step dead-pr-waits): its work landed on main in a8a9fcdd5 (#2553, batch 72j). Back to ready 07:22 CST Nov 12 (coordinator yes 07:21 CST): no live lane (was runner 8 session_013NEJL2vsmyKzJm8jUDt6za (agents)).
